item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 28/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring fine weather to southern China persistently in the next couple of days. Under the influence of a replenishment of the northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nalgae is expected to intensify gradually, and move across Luzon towards the northeastern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement and intensity.
